verseText: After this I looked and saw a multitude too large to count, from every nation and tribe and people and tongue, standing before the throne and before the Lamb.
meaning: This describes God's future forever kingdom, where people from all over the world will worship him together.

recall.question: A “multitude” is a huge crowd, and “tongue” means language here. Who did John see standing before the throne?
choices: People from every nation and language
Only people who spoke his language

meaning.question: Jesus is called “the Lamb” because He gave His life to save us. What does this crowd before Him show us about God’s family?
choices: Jesus saves people from all over the world
Only people from one nation can belong
Everyone must speak Jesus' language to belong

application.prompt: Imagine a crowd too big to count, with people from every part of the world worshiping Jesus together. How could this picture help you welcome someone who comes from a different place than you do?
